report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 78ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. Only one ERROR trace shows a 1997ms gateway->order call. This single span cannot establish a bounded root cause among the taxonomy options, and healthy metrics contradict a broad gateway fault. Handing off for downstream order-path evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to explain the 1997ms ERROR span from gateway
Gateway error-rate and p95 metrics broken down per downstream dependency
Order-to-postgresql, payment, and inventory dependency latency and error telemetry
Whether the single ERROR trace is representative or an isolated outlier
